new_today_news.headline: Restaurant Sector July 2026 Update
new_today_news.summary: Restaurant brands navigate inflation, shifting consumer behavior, and rising costs as they prepare for renewed IPO opportunities, with Ankura's July 2026 update examining trends from Jersey Mike's and Inspire Brands' anticipated public offerings.

recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Q2 2026 Earnings: Profit Soars 29x YoY with $2.41 EPS Beat on Stronger Fat and Protein Prices
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported Q2 2026 net income of $387 million ($2.41 EPS), significantly beating analyst estimates of $1.27. Net sales reached $1.7 billion, falling short of $1.7 billion forecast. Strong fat/protein prices and operational execution drove results.

recent_news.headline: GFL Environmental Reports 16.3% Q2 Revenue Growth; Acquisitions Drive Nearly 10 Percentage Points
recent_news.summary: GFL Environmental achieved Q2 2026 revenue growth of 16.3%, with acquisitions contributing 9.9 percentage points and organic growth contributing 6.4 percentage points. Company completed acquisitions generating estimated $435–460 million in annualized revenue during H1 2026.

backfill_news.headline: Heights Brewing Announces Closure After Aug. 2
backfill_news.summary: Michigan brewery announces closure citing rising cost of goods, loan payments, and unforeseen challenges. Reflects current industry margin pressures.
